title: Family: his uncle the drummer
summary: Only his uncle Christopher Miner played music, drums; Minor gives his address and age. No other musicians in the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything about your family as much as you can remember about your parents? Did they play any musical instruments?
Well I had an uncle, I still have an uncle, and he was playing drums.
His name is Christopher Miner. Do you have his address or can you tell me?
At the present time I don't have his address, but he lives on Polgar between Claiborne and Durban. About two doors from Claiborne.
And which side of the street? They're down?
They live on the uptown side.
Uptown. And a couple of doors from Claiborne. How is his health? Is he able to talk?
Oh yeah, he's still working. Still working and all, isn't he? Yeah, he's still working. How old is he about? He's around about 61 or 62.
That's not so old then. I thought maybe he'd be a little bit older.
No, he was about 61 or 62. That's all I know.

I know Professor Minetta talked about he used to play a few more years ago. Back in the old days in the district and all. That's right. The past is about 72 now. Yes. Or will be 72. I thought your uncle would be about that age. No, he's not that old. He's younger. I knew that he played drums. So we'll talk to him and get his story directly. Is that somebody at your door? Yes. If you want to stop any time, we can just turn this off. It doesn't have to be any special order or not. No. Did your father play any instruments?
No, my father didn't play anything.
Nobody but my uncle. That's the only one.
That's your uncle then. Did you have any brothers or sisters to play?
No brothers or sisters. Only one.
